subject.title: 🦞 Tracking: Local gateway is the golden path for the Windows companion app

question: Should this epic keep its broad definition of done, or be narrowed now that current main implements most of the local WSL setup and restart-recovery architecture?
rationale: This collaborator-authored epic spans Windows UX, persistent gateway state, and upstream gateway behavior; deciding whether the remaining child issues still define the golden path requires roadmap and acceptance judgment.

options.title: Keep and reconcile
options.body: Retain the epic as canonical, audit each child against current main, and close it only after current-release end-to-end proof satisfies the remaining outcome.

options.title: Narrow remaining scope
options.body: Rewrite the epic around only the still-unproven rollback, bypass, and first-use outcomes while closing implemented children.

options.title: Retire the direction
options.body: Close the epic only if maintainers explicitly decide that an app-owned local gateway is no longer the Windows companion app's recommended default.

recommendation.title: Keep and reconcile
recommendation.body: Retain the epic as canonical, audit each child against current main, and close it only after current-release end-to-end proof satisfies the remaining outcome.

likelyOwner.reason: Authored and recently curated the epic and its product decomposition, making this person the best available owner for scope and completion criteria.
